name: io.github.zColdWater/mcp-launch-audit
title: OmniForge Launch Audit MCP
description: Audit brand domains, USPTO trademarks, SPF/DKIM/DMARC email, and AI search (llms.txt) readiness.

tools.name: check_brand_availability
tools.description: Check a single candidate startup or product name across top TLDs (.com, .io, .ai, .dev via live RDAP/DNS), public developer handles (GitHub, npm, PyPI, Bluesky), and live USPTO trademark records, returning a 0-100 Brand Readiness Score. Use this tool when evaluating candidate names before registering a domain; use `full_launch_readiness_audit` instead when auditing an already-chosen domain across brand, email DNS, and AI search visibility together.

name.description: Candidate brand or product name to screen (alphanumeric label, e.g. 'linear' or 'resend').

tlds.description: Optional list of domain extensions without leading dots (defaults to ['com', 'io', 'ai', 'dev'], max 6).

tools.name: audit_email_deliverability
tools.description: Audit a sending domain's email authentication and inbox placement health: resolves MX servers, recursively counts SPF DNS lookups against the RFC 7208 10-lookup hard limit, probes 18 standard ESP DKIM selectors, validates DMARC policy enforcement, checks MTA-STS/BIMI, and tests the primary mail IP against major DNSBL blacklists. Use this tool for diagnosing why transactional or marketing emails land in spam; use `full_launch_readiness_audit` when also checking brand conflicts and AI search crawlers.

domain.description: Target sending domain to inspect (e.g. 'stripe.com' or 'acme.io').

tools.name: audit_ai_search_visibility
tools.description: Inspect a live website URL for Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) and AI assistant citation readiness: verifies whether `/robots.txt` allows 8 major AI search crawlers (OAI-SearchBot, GPTBot, ChatGPT-User, PerplexityBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, Applebot-Extended, CCBot), validates `/llms.txt` and `/llms-full.txt` Markdown indexes, and extracts Schema.org `application/ld+json` entities. Use this tool for AI SEO and `/llms.txt` checks on a single URL; use `full_launch_readiness_audit` when running a complete pre-launch sweep.

url.description: Public website URL or domain to inspect (e.g. 'https://cal.com' or 'linear.app').

tools.name: full_launch_readiness_audit
tools.description: Run a comprehensive, parallel 3-pillar pre-launch audit on a production domain — combining brand/trademark conflict screening, SPF/DKIM/DMARC/DNSBL email deliverability verification, and AI search (`robots.txt`, `/llms.txt`, Schema.org JSON-LD) readiness into one unified 0-100 Launch Scorecard and prioritized remediation checklist. Reach for this tool when preparing a domain for launch or diagnosing overall technical growth readiness; use the specialized single-pillar tools when iterating on just one area.

domain.description: Primary production domain to audit (e.g. 'resend.com' or 'acme.io').

brandName.description: Optional brand label if different from the domain's second-level label.
